about: Which 1-degree cells hold land, from the tiled sources' own published tile lists, so hydro acquisition asks only for tiles over land (gpuwm.hydro.acquire). A cell missing from its roster is sea: the tile is never requested and is listed in its directory's ABSENT.txt, the list rw_hydro_world and rw_hydro_params read to tell sea from a missing download. A new tiled source is a row here. Breakage it prevents: a mostly-ocean hurricane domain (Milton, 23 x 17 degrees) asked 1,001 tile URLs, most of them open sea answering 404.
